output.reason: The cited spans show that paragraph 261(1) applies only to floating-rate loans for non-business purposes to individuals, and paragraph 261(2) applies only to floating-rate loans for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises. The residual clause in 261(5) covers cases other than 261(1) and (2), which includes a fixed-rate loan to a private limited company/non-individual. So the statement that the documents do not state a specific restriction for that loan type follows from the spans.
